extraction.name: VQAonline
extraction.description: The first Visual Question Answering (VQA) dataset in which all contents originate from an authentic use case, sourced from online question answering community forums (Stack Exchange). It features authentic context, answers validated by the question asker, lengthy answers (mean of 173 words), and user-chosen topics from 105 diverse topics.
extraction.creator: Chongyan Chen, Mengchen Liu, Noel Codella, Yunsheng Li, Lu Yuan, Danna Gurari
extraction.publisher: University of Texas at Austin, Microsoft, University of Colorado Boulder
extraction.inLanguage: English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Korean, Russian
extraction.citeAs: Chen, C., Liu, M., Codella, N., Li, Y., Yuan, L., & Gurari, D. (2024). Fully Authentic Visual Question Answering Dataset from Online Communities. arXiv:2311.15562v4.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Scraping data from the online question-answering platform Stack Exchange. Collected examples containing a natural language question, a natural language context, an image, and at least one answer. The natural language question was the post 'title', the image a URL link, the context the 'body' text entry, and answers were provided by other users. Only examples with an 'accepted answer' marked by the asker were used.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Visual questions without an accepted answer were removed. Visual questions with scores of 0 or less for either the question or answer were removed. Visual questions with multiple images or visual answers were excluded. Examples for which the image could not be downloaded from the provided link were removed.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Converted all images to png format for data format consistency.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: 1. Removed visual questions without an accepted answer. 2. Removed visual questions with scores of 0 or less for either the question or answer. 3. Excluded visual questions with multiple images (e.g., GIF). 4. Excluded visual questions with visual answers. 5. Removed examples for which the image could not be downloaded. 6. Created training, validation, and test splits (665, 285, and 63,746 examples respectively) by randomly selecting from each of the 105 topics.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: User Intention Annotation: Crowdworkers annotated the intent for 105 examples (one from each topic). Three crowdworkers from Amazon Mechanical Turk labeled each instance. Two workers labeled independently; if they disagreed, a third worker broke the tie. The final label was the majority vote. Image Content Analysis: Researchers manually labeled 105 images (one per topic) and 100 random images for screenshot/infographic presence and image necessity. Domain Expert Evaluation: Ten domain experts rated model-generated answers for 200 VQAs.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Amazon Mechanical Turk, Home-grown web-based interface
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: For user intention annotation, 25 out of 105 pairs of annotations didn't match between the first two workers, requiring a third worker. The final label was determined by majority vote. During taxonomy development by authors, agreement accuracy improved from 53.3% to 87.5% and Cohen’s kappa improved from 45.24% to 84.69% across four rounds.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 3 (for user intention subset of 105 items); 1 (accepted answer for main dataset)
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Crowdworkers: Located in the United States, completed >500 HITs, >95% approval rating. Domain Experts: Located in the United States, at least a Master's degree in a field related to their assigned VQA topic.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Improved models can benefit real-world applications including community question answering platforms (e.g., Yahoo! Answers, Quora), learning assistance VQA tools for children, virtual assistants, visual dialog and query, and visual search and browsing.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Poor representation of people in poverty-stricken areas (requires mobile devices and Internet). Unbalanced geographic representation (more from US, India, Europe; less from countries like Egypt). Language bias (English dominant, performance varies by language).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Answers are much longer than standard VQA datasets, making standard evaluation metrics ineffective. Potential data contamination as models may have been trained on Stack Exchange data. Images are not always necessary to answer the question (34.3% unnecessary).
